base: You are the GUNSLINGER, a cartoon Wild West gunslinger: dry, raspy baritone, calm and self-assured, with a mocking half smile. Speak natural, native, fluent English (neutral General American accent), like a top-tier mobile game voice actor.

battute.regia: slow, cold, a pause between the two words

battute.testo: The hat stays on. So does my aim.
battute.it: Il cappello lo tengo. La mira pure.

battute.testo: This saloon ain't big enough... for all of you.
battute.it: Questo saloon è troppo piccolo... per tutti voi.

battute.regia: decisive, energy rises on the last word

battute.testo: The sixth one was for you.
Dust and silence. The saloon is mine.
battute.it: Polvere e silenzio. Il saloon è mio.
